reviewIdentity: Exact working-tree file SHA-256 values; no committed-head or merge approval is implied
scope: Read-only static review of bounded list_directory implementation, focused fixtures, actual packed-package verifier, pinned handler and provisional contract report

findings.finding: The provisional verifier read systemInfo directly from structuredContent; get_config returns structuredContent.config and prefixes its text representation. This would fail before directory scenarios and leave product PID unidentified.
findings.resolution: Verifier now asserts the structured envelope and reads structuredContent.config.systemInfo.processInfo.pid. It also asserts a positive captured npm transport PID.
findings.qualification: Found before installed verifier execution; no product runtime defect or observed native test failure is claimed.

findings.area: Directory handle ownership before first iterator read
findings.finding: Cancellation or deadline expiry during successful opendir could call return on an unstarted async generator; Node's Dir iterator finally-close had not been entered, leaving the acquired handle open.
findings.resolution: Runtime records whether iterator.next began. Its finally returns the started iterator or explicitly closes the unstarted acquired stream. Two real-Dir fixtures require zero next calls and ERR_DIR_CLOSED after cancellation/deadline.
findings.qualification: Reviewer inspected local Node internal/fs/dir source and retained worker RED/GREEN logs; reviewer did not execute tests.

findings.finding: The implementation throws root validation/schema/open errors but converts operational iterator or close errors after root opening into partial diagnostics. The provisional report describes nested operational errors and a broad root-failure distinction.
findings.recommendation: Describe root mid-stream operational failures precisely, separately from root policy/schema/open failures, or explicitly choose a narrower contract before claiming full acceptance.
findings.resolution: The revised paragraph and intentional-difference table expressly distinguish root policy/schema/open failures from incomplete results after operational read/close interruption of an already-open root or nested directory.
findings.securityAssessment: ToolError and cancellation remain failures; no policy bypass was found.

staticChecks.boundedRetainedEntries: At most 1000 root and 100 nested candidates per visit; global iterator inspection stops at 4000 without an EOF lookahead.
staticChecks.selection: Code-unit lexical prefix is independent of enumeration order for completed enumeration; interrupted scans make no complete-membership promise.
staticChecks.counts: Private names are excluded before eligible counts; exact totals require observed EOF and complete emission.
staticChecks.deadline: Cooperative checks surround enumeration and post-policy emission; pending OS operations are not preempted.
staticChecks.byteBudget: Every emitted text line includes its UTF-8 bytes plus any preceding newline in the 262144-byte budget.
staticChecks.errors: Known operational codes map to fixed diagnostics; raw filesystem messages are not printed. Root authorization, private paths, link policy and cancellation remain enforced.
staticChecks.cleanup: Started iterators are returned; unstarted acquired directory streams are explicitly closed. Installed verifier independently checks captured npm and product PID exit before deleting only its owned directory fixture.
staticChecks.installedCalls: Real MCP SDK calls and exact text/envelope assertions cover six directory scenario groups through the actual tarball/npm-exec path; no fabricated response path was added.
staticChecks.unrelatedScope: No changes to policy roots, owner enrollment, credentials, deployment, model invocation, protocol transport or process execution were found in the reviewed runtime diff.

retainedEvidenceInspected.observedResult: Two targeted fixtures failed at the real-handle ERR_DIR_CLOSED assertion before the cleanup repair.
18 tests passed, zero failures/cancellations/skips after repair.
